source: Génère une grande scène de show en 3D avec un dispositif d'éclairage dynamique, des écrans géants, des effets de fumée, une immense estrade et une musique de fond stylée et dynamique, avec un système de contrôle interactif.

image_prompt.text: An immense raised stage as the hero build, composed to be framed from anywhere on the floor in front of it
Arrival placed and oriented so the first thing a visitor sees is the stage front lit up, never the rigging behind it
A dynamic lighting rig above and around the stage - trusses, spotlights and moving heads throwing coloured beams across the space
Giant video screens flanking and backing the stage, facing the floor
Smoke effects drifting up around the stage edges and through the light beams

layout_placement.text: Spawn on the floor facing the stage
Small optional finds tucked around the edges of the venue for visitors who wander off the floor

notes: The prompt is French; layout content is a stage, a lighting rig, giant screens, smoke and background music, plus an interactive control system.

Background music and the interactive control system have no home in this handoff. If the control system means a physical desk or booth that operators stand at, it is geometry and should be added - the prompt does not say.
No audience area, seating or crowd capacity was specified, so none was placed.

open_questions.ask: What style should the venue read as - a modern arena concert, a festival main stage, a nightclub?
Is there an audience area with a defined capacity, or is the stage the whole build?
Who operates the interactive control system - is it a physical console in the world, or a screen menu?

coverage_missing.ask: What visual register - sleek modern arena, gritty festival, neon club?
How many players should the floor hold?
Do visitors perform on the stage, or watch it?

answers.ask: What style should the venue read as - a modern arena concert, a festival main stage, a nightclub?
answers.answer: Le lieu doit être une scène principale de festival moderne, avec une esthétique spectaculaire et dynamique.

answers.ask: Is there an audience area with a defined capacity, or is the stage the whole build?
answers.answer: Ajoutez une zone de public simple devant l’estrade, sans capacité définie ; la scène reste l’élément central du build.

answers.ask: Who operates the interactive control system - is it a physical console in the world, or a screen menu?
answers.answer: Le système se contrôle via une console physique interactive placée sur le côté de la scène.
